title: Local Market Hub - Frontend Implementation Plan

requirements.summary: Implement user authentication with three role types using Internet Identity and authorization component
acceptanceCriteria: Users can register and login using Internet Identity
System assigns one of three roles: Customer, Shopkeeper, or Admin
Role is persisted and enforced across all portal access

file_operations.description: Create login button component using authorization component's Internet Identity integration with login/logout functionality, handling authentication state and clearing cached data on logout

Create modal component for first-time user profile setup that captures name and role selection (Customer, Shopkeeper, Admin), integrating with authorization component's user profile system via getCallerUserProfile and saveCallerUserProfile

Create authentication hook that wraps authorization component's useInternetIdentity to provide isAuthenticated, identity, and user profile state, preventing profile setup modal flash by properly handling actor dependency. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create role-based access control guard component that checks user's appRole from UserProfile and conditionally renders content or access denied screen based on required role (customer, shopkeeper, admin)

requirements.summary: Create Customer portal with shop browsing filtered by manually set city/area location
acceptanceCriteria: Customers can filter shops by city or area designation
Shop listings display name, category, and online/offline status
Only shops marked as 'Online' appear in active listings

file_operations.description: Create customer shop browsing page with location filter input (city/area text field), calling getShopsByLocation backend method to fetch filtered shops, displaying shop cards showing name, location, online/offline status badge, with visual distinction for online vs offline shops

Create shop card component displaying shop name, location, and online/offline status with Trust-Blue styling for online shops and muted styling for offline shops, with click handler to navigate to shop detail page
Create React Query hook for fetching shops using getShops and getShopsByLocation backend methods, with filtering logic to show only approved and online shops to customers

requirements.summary: Implement category-based product search with predefined categories
acceptanceCriteria: Products are tagged with one primary category
Customers can filter products by category across all shops or within a single shop
Category filter updates product listings dynamically

file_operations.description: Create product browsing page with category filter dropdown (Grocery, Electronics, Fashion, Home & Garden, Health & Beauty, Sports & Outdoors) calling getProducts or getProductsByCategory backend methods, with optional shop filter to view products from single shop

Create product card component displaying product image (using ExternalBlob's getDirectURL method for browser-cached streaming), name, price, category badge, stock status, and Quick-Add button. Verify the blob-storage component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create category filter component with dropdown or button group for all six predefined categories, triggering product list refresh when category selection changes
Create React Query hook for fetching products using getProducts, getProductsByCategory, and getProductsByLocation backend methods with query key management for filter-based refetching

requirements.summary: Build shopping cart with Quick-Add functionality and quantity adjustment
acceptanceCriteria: Customers can add products to cart with a single click
Cart displays all items with product name, price, quantity, and subtotal
Customers can adjust quantities or remove items before checkout

file_operations.description: Create cart sidebar component displaying cart items from getCart backend method, showing product name, price, quantity stepper, subtotal per item, and cart total with Success-Green styling for add-to-cart confirmations

Create cart item component with quantity adjustment controls calling updateCartItem backend method, remove button, and displaying product thumbnail using ExternalBlob's getDirectURL. Verify the blob-storage component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create React Query hook managing cart state with mutations for addToCart, updateCartItem, and checkout backend methods, including optimistic updates and cart invalidation after successful checkout

requirements.summary: Create secure checkout process that calculates order total, applies 2% platform commission, and records transaction
acceptanceCriteria: Checkout displays itemized order summary with total amount
System calculates and records 2% commission on each sale
Order is created with status 'Pending' after checkout completion
Cart is cleared after successful order placement

file_operations.description: Create checkout page displaying itemized cart summary, order total calculation, calling checkout backend method which handles commission calculation and order creation, then redirecting to order confirmation with Success-Green success indicators

Create order summary component displaying line items with product name, quantity, price, subtotals, and grand total, with clear typography hierarchy and Trust-Blue primary action button for checkout confirmation

requirements.summary: Implement My Orders section for customers showing order history with status tracking
acceptanceCriteria: Customers can view all their past and current orders
Each order displays: order ID, date, shop name, items, total amount, and current status
Order statuses include: Pending, Confirmed, Preparing, Ready for Pickup, Completed, Cancelled
Customers can manually refresh to see updated order status

file_operations.description: Create customer orders page fetching orders via getMyOrders backend method, displaying order cards with order ID, timestamp, shop name, status badge, total amount, and manual refresh button with Trust-Blue styling

Create order card component showing order details, status badge with color coding (Success-Green for completed, Trust-Blue for in-progress, yellow for pending, red for cancelled), and expandable item list
Create React Query hook for fetching customer orders using getMyOrders backend method with manual refetch capability and query invalidation on status changes

requirements.summary: Add Return/Exchange request functionality allowing customers to submit requests for completed orders
acceptanceCriteria: Customers can initiate return or exchange request on completed orders
Request form captures: order ID, reason (dropdown: Damaged, Wrong Item, Quality Issue, Changed Mind), and optional description
Request is submitted to admin for review
Customer can view status of their return/exchange requests

file_operations.description: Create return request modal component with order ID display, reason dropdown (Damaged, Wrong Item, Quality Issue, Changed Mind), optional description textarea, calling requestReturn backend method, with Success-Green confirmation on submission
Create return requests tracking page displaying customer's submitted return/exchange requests with status, reason, and linked order ID

requirements.summary: Create Shopkeeper portal with online/offline status toggle visible to customers
acceptanceCriteria: Shopkeepers can toggle their shop status between Online and Offline
Status change is reflected immediately in customer-facing shop listings
Offline shops do not appear in active customer browsing

file_operations.description: Create shopkeeper dashboard page with online/offline toggle switch calling toggleShopStatus backend method, displaying current shop status with Success-Green for online and gray for offline, with immediate UI feedback and query invalidation
Create shop status toggle component with visual switch control, calling toggleShopStatus backend method with optimistic update and rollback on error, using Trust-Blue and Success-Green color states

requirements.summary: Build inventory management system for shopkeepers to add, edit, and delete products with photo upload
acceptanceCriteria: Shopkeepers can add new products with: name, description, price, category, stock quantity, and product image
Image upload stores photo as static asset accessible via frontend
Shopkeepers can edit existing product details including replacing product image
Shopkeepers can delete products from their inventory
Products marked as out-of-stock are visually indicated but remain visible

file_operations.description: Create inventory management page displaying shopkeeper's products from getProducts backend method filtered by their shopId, with add/edit/delete actions and out-of-stock visual indicators using muted styling

Create product form modal for add/edit operations with fields for name, description, price, category dropdown, stock quantity, and image upload using ExternalBlob.fromBytes for image handling with upload progress tracking, calling addProduct or updateProduct backend methods. Verify the blob-storage component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create inventory product card component showing product details, stock status badge, edit and delete buttons, product image thumbnail using ExternalBlob's getDirectURL, with Trust-Blue action buttons. Verify the blob-storage component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create React Query hook for inventory operations with mutations for addProduct, updateProduct, and deleteProduct backend methods, including query invalidation and optimistic updates

requirements.summary: Implement order management dashboard for shopkeepers to view incoming orders and update order status
acceptanceCriteria: Shopkeepers see all orders placed at their shop sorted by date (newest first)
Each order displays: order ID, customer name, items ordered, total amount, and current status
Shopkeepers can update order status through workflow: Pending → Confirmed → Preparing → Ready for Pickup → Completed
Shopkeepers can cancel orders with reason

file_operations.description: Create shopkeeper orders page fetching orders via getShopOrders backend method filtered by shopkeeper's shopId, sorted by timestamp descending, displaying order cards with status update controls

Create shop order card component showing order details, customer name from UserProfile lookup, status workflow buttons (Confirm, Prepare, Ready, Complete) calling updateOrderStatus backend method, with Success-Green progress indicators
Create order status control component with workflow-based action buttons that enable next valid status transition based on current status, with cancel order option displaying reason input modal
Create React Query hook for shopkeeper orders using getShopOrders backend method with mutation for updateOrderStatus and query invalidation on status changes

requirements.summary: Create digital ledger for shopkeepers showing sales history with 2% platform commission breakdown per transaction
acceptanceCriteria: Ledger displays all completed orders with: date, order ID, gross sale amount, 2% commission deducted, and net earning
Running totals show: total sales, total commission paid, and net earnings for current month and all-time
Ledger is filterable by date range

file_operations.description: Create digital ledger page displaying completed orders from getShopOrders backend method filtered by 'delivered' status, showing per-transaction breakdown with gross sale, 2% commission calculation, and net earning, plus running totals section with Trust-Blue summary cards
Create ledger table component with columns for date, order ID, gross amount, commission (2%), and net earning, with date range filter controls and sortable columns

Create ledger summary component displaying aggregated statistics cards for total sales, total commission paid, net earnings for current month and all-time, calculated from filtered order data with Success-Green positive indicators

requirements.summary: Build Admin dashboard with secure login and overview showing platform-wide statistics
acceptanceCriteria: Admin role has separate authenticated access via Internet Identity
Dashboard displays: total registered shops, pending shop approvals, total customers, total orders, total platform revenue (2% commissions)
Statistics are updated when admin views the dashboard

file_operations.description: Create admin dashboard page protected by RoleGuard requiring admin role, fetching platform statistics from getPlatformStats backend method, displaying stat cards for total shops, pending approvals, total customers, total orders, and platform commission revenue with Trust-Blue styling
Create reusable stat card component displaying metric label, value, and optional trend indicator with Trust-Blue and Success-Green color scheme
Create React Query hook for fetching platform statistics using getPlatformStats backend method with periodic refetch on dashboard view

requirements.summary: Implement shop management system for admin to approve/verify new shop registrations and view shop performance metrics
acceptanceCriteria: New shop registrations require admin approval before becoming active
Admin sees pending shop applications with details: shop name, owner name, location, category
Admin can approve or reject shop applications with optional notes
Admin can view shop performance: total orders, total sales, average order value, customer ratings (if available)

file_operations.description: Create shop management page fetching all shops via getShops backend method with tabs for pending approvals and approved shops, showing shop details and admin action buttons with Trust-Blue primary actions

Create shop approval card component displaying pending shop details with owner name lookup from getUserProfile, location, approve button calling approveShop backend method, with Success-Green approval confirmation
Create shop performance card component calculating and displaying shop metrics from orders data: total orders count, total sales sum, average order value, with expandable details view
Create React Query hook for shop management operations with mutations for approveShop backend method and queries for getShops with filtering by approval status

requirements.summary: Create transaction analytics dashboard for admin showing total sales, pending 2% commissions, and subscription tracking
acceptanceCriteria: Analytics page shows: total platform sales, total commission collected (2%), pending commission from recent orders
Track shopkeeper annual subscriptions (₹25/year) with renewal dates
Display list of shops with upcoming or overdue subscription renewals
Analytics filterable by date range and exportable summary

file_operations.description: Create analytics dashboard page displaying financial metrics from getPlatformStats and calculated commission data from orders, with date range filter and subscription tracking table showing ₹25 annual fee status with Trust-Blue data visualization
Create commission breakdown component displaying total commission collected (2% of all sales), pending commission from recent orders not yet completed, with Success-Green positive indicators
Create subscription tracking table component displaying shops with subscription status, renewal dates, and overdue indicators for ₹25 annual fee, with sortable columns

requirements.summary: Build user support ticket system for admin to manage disputes between customers and shopkeepers
acceptanceCriteria: Customers and shopkeepers can create support tickets with: subject, description, related order ID (optional), and priority
Admin views all tickets with status: Open, In Progress, Resolved, Closed
Admin can add internal notes to tickets
Admin can update ticket status and mark resolution
Users can view their submitted tickets and admin responses

file_operations.description: Create admin tickets page fetching all tickets via getAllTickets backend method, displaying ticket list with status filter tabs (Open, In Progress, Resolved, Closed), with Trust-Blue active tab styling

Create ticket card component showing ticket details, customer/shopkeeper info from getUserProfile lookup, issue description, status update controls calling updateTicketStatus backend method, with color-coded status badges
Create customer tickets page displaying user's submitted tickets with status and issue details, with create new ticket button opening ticket creation modal

Create ticket creation modal component with form fields for issue description and optional related order ID, calling createSupportTicket backend method, accessible to both customers and shopkeepers with Success-Green submission confirmation
Create React Query hook for ticket operations with queries for getAllTickets (admin) and user-specific tickets, mutations for createSupportTicket and updateTicketStatus backend methods

requirements.summary: Implement global settings panel for admin to adjust platform-wide delivery radius filter and manage platform configuration
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can set a default delivery radius value (in kilometers) used for shop location filtering guidance
Admin can configure platform-wide settings: platform name, commission rate (default 2%), annual subscription fee (default ₹25)
Settings changes are applied immediately across the platform

file_operations.description: Create admin settings page with form inputs for delivery radius (km), commission rate (%), annual subscription fee (₹), and platform name, with save button and Trust-Blue primary action styling, Success-Green save confirmation
Create settings form component with validated number inputs for numeric settings, text input for platform name, with real-time validation and save/reset controls

requirements.summary: Design mobile-first responsive UI with Trust-Blue and Success-Green color palette across all portals
acceptanceCriteria: All portal interfaces are fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices (320px and up)
Primary color palette uses Trust-Blue (#1E3A8A or similar) for primary actions, headers, and trust elements
Success-Green (#10B981 or similar) used for confirmations, success states, and positive indicators
Typography, spacing, and touch targets follow mobile-first best practices
Navigation is intuitive with clear role-based menu structure

file_operations.description: Update global styles to define Trust-Blue (#1E3A8A) and Success-Green (#10B981) CSS custom properties, mobile-first responsive typography scale, touch-friendly spacing utilities, and baseline mobile layout styles
Extend Tailwind theme with custom Trust-Blue and Success-Green color definitions, mobile-first breakpoints, and responsive spacing scale optimized for 320px minimum width

Create responsive app layout component with mobile-first navigation structure, role-based menu items (customer, shopkeeper, admin sections), collapsible mobile menu, using Trust-Blue header and navigation styling
Create mobile navigation component with hamburger menu, slide-out drawer, and role-based navigation links with Trust-Blue active states and touch-friendly tap targets (minimum 44x44px)
Create role-based navigation component that renders appropriate menu items based on user's appRole (customer, shopkeeper, admin) from UserProfile, with conditional route visibility

Wire AppLayout into App component, wrap routes with authentication check and RoleGuard components, add route definitions for all customer, shopkeeper, and admin pages created in this plan, integrate ProfileSetupModal for first-time users. Reference generated hero banner image at frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-banner.dim_1200x400.png and portal icons (customer-icon.dim_64x64.png, shopkeeper-icon.dim_64x64.png, admin-icon.dim_64x64.png) in the navigation or dashboard sections.
